title: METHODS OF ASSOCIATING GENETIC VARIANTS WITH CLINICAL OUTCOME IN PATIENTS SUFFERING FROM AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION TREATED WITH ANTI-VEGF
abstract: To provide use of a vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) inhibitor in production of a drug for treating a macular degeneration patient.SOLUTION: A VEGF inhibitor has been already administered to a patient for about one year, and the patient has one or more single nucleotide polymorphisms selected from a group consisting of rs2056688, rs5962084, rs5962087, rs5915722, rs5962095, rs2106124, rs1879796, rs12148845, rs12148100, rs17482885 and rs17629019.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
